name: Driven pile and skirt-pile foundations
description: Transfer jacket/tower loads into soil by axial and lateral resistance; skirt piles are driven through sleeves at jacket base corners. Primary source: https://www.offshore-technology.com/projects/baldpate/

specifications.basis: Offshore Technology Baldpate: three 84 in-diameter, 530 ft skirt-pile sleeves at each of four bottom corners; 12 foundation piles installed by Heerema; penetrations approaching 430 ft
Offshore Technology Mexilhão: 3,150 t tubular steel piles up to 120 m long

applications: Transfer jacket/tower loads into soil by axial and lateral resistance; skirt piles are driven through sleeves at jacket base corners.
